The Lord of the Rings will forever be one of the greatest film trilogies to ever hit the silver screen.  Not counting The Hobbit movies, The Lord of the Rings changed the landscape of adapting classic novels to the big screen. Though one member of the Fellowship didn't quite live up to his novel counterpart.
